title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 7
body: His gym selfies have more captions than his texts to you. He knows his daily protein but not your birthday. He says "I'm focusing on myself" and posts another mirror pic. Self love is great. Self love with no space for you is just a solo project with a girlfriend as audience.
caption:
Save this before your next situationship.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 7
body: She texts "miss you" at midnight and "who is this" at noon. Monday she is warm, Tuesday she is ice. You have learned to check her mood like the weather. Do not ask. Just look outside. If there is a storm, bring snacks and apologise for something.
caption:
Which one is you? Be honest.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 7
body: His biodata says "Business." What business? "Family business." Which one? "Various things." Various things means he stands in his father's shop on Sundays. Hers says "fair, educated, homely." A rishta meeting is a presentation with no slides and a lot of tea.
caption:
Save this for the next aunty visit.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 7
body: Your friends say "she is not into you." You say "but she replied to my story." A story reply is not a relationship. It is a heart from the algorithm. You are building a house on a laughing emoji. It will not hold in the first rain.
caption:
Send this to someone who needs a clear no.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 7
body: He says "let's keep it casual" and tells you his marriage timeline by the main course. "I'm not looking for anything serious" and "my mother wants to meet you" in the same dinner. Contradictions go well with biryani. Order one and watch the show.
caption:
Tag your date's group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 7
body: He texts only after 11pm. Brave only after midnight. In the daytime he is a ghost. "Missed you" at 2am, "who is this" at 2pm. Night mode is not a personality. If you only exist when his Wi-Fi and his loneliness are both on, you are a late night snack.
caption:
Send this to the one who reads and does not reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 7
body: You get a two hour voice note about a guy who ignored her. You send a paragraph of advice. She replies "haha true" and goes back to him. Your advice has a zero percent adoption rate. You are a free consultant who is never invited to the meeting.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs to stop being the helpline.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 7
body: Ask a direct question: "what are we?" He says "why label things?" Because labels are for people he is committed to. A clear question needs a clear answer. If he has to think about it, you have your answer. If he changes the subject, you have the full report.
caption:
Screenshot this for your next situationship.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 7
body: No photos of you, ever. He says "I'm not into posting." But he posted his chai, his shoes, his cousin's wedding and a stranger's dog. You are less visible than a cup of chai. Being private is fine. Being invisible on purpose is a message.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs an Instagram audit.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 7
body: Women have a taxi light too. She says "I don't want to settle" at twenty five. By twenty nine, her mother is sending proposals and she is saying yes to the second one. The light comes on. Whoever is in the car at that moment gets chosen. The rest wait.
caption:
Tag the friend waiting for him to be ready.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 7
body: "Don't worry, we'll handle it." They have handled your rishta for four years. Handled means rejected fourteen, delayed six, and lost one to a cousin who got engaged on a different group. You are not stuck. You are in a very slow handover process.
caption:
Tag the friend whose uncle has opinions.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 7
body: "I'm manifesting a relationship with you." You have not replied. He is manifesting, you are ignoring. He wrote your name in a journal and thinks you are legally obligated. You can manifest a job for him. That is a better use of the universe.
caption:
Tag the friend who dated a life coach.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 7
body: The word "fair" appears forty times. The word "kind" appears once, near the bottom, in small font. We know our priorities. Tell the matchmaker you want someone who likes you, not someone who matches the paint chart. She will write "fussy" in her notes.
caption:
Send this to the matchmaker aunty.
